items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: Al) Hibbler was sitting with the band... Hibbler was standing in front of me.

ctx.x: She sang it (inaudible) it rained. Everytime she sang that goddamned song with the band. No kidding. I'm not superstitious, I'm nothing like that. But I swear she sang it. And another thing. (Al) Hibbler was sitting with the band. Now we come to Atlanta, Georgia. Man, the place was crowded, packed and jammed. The colored could dance but the whites were spectators up in the galleries. White couldn't dance; colored could dance.

So everything is going along fine. Fine, fine. Got damn Hibbler, Hibbler say, "Hey, Duke, I want to sing my big one, sing the biggie, 'Don't Take Your Love Away From Me.'" Remember that song, "Don't Take Your Love Away from Me".
